project_site.question: Is the EITI project this site: the same site, one a part of what the other covers, two parts of one site, or a site processing its output?
choices: The same site: the project is the same mine or field as the site
Part of the site: the project is one licence, block or phase of the mine or field the site covers
The site is part of it: the site is one licence, block or phase of the mine or field the project covers
Parts of one site: the project and the site are different licences, blocks or phases of one mine or field, which neither covers whole
Its output processed there: the site is a smelter, refinery or plant that processes the project's output
Not of one mine or field

site_membership.question: Do these two records describe one site: the same site, one a part of what the other describes, or two parts of one site?
choices: The same site: the record describes the same mine or field as the other record
Part of the other: the record describes one licence, block or phase of the mine or field the other record describes
The other is part of it: the other record describes one licence, block or phase of the mine or field the record describes
Parts of one site: the record and the other record describe different licences, blocks or phases of one mine or field, which neither describes whole
